flags.person: Greater Clark board incl. Brian Jones, John Buckwalter, Tamara Tammy Yenawine Mustain
flags.summary: In December 2025 the board voted 6-0 (Chelsea Crump recused) against the administration's recommendation to fire a Riverside Elementary physical education teacher who had been arrested in Kentucky on Sept. 6, 2025 and had not reported the arrest as district policy requires; he remained employed. Mustain said she voted no because the board did not have 'enough credible evidence to terminate his contract.' Buckwalter and Vice President Teresa Bottorff Perkins did not respond to requests for comment.
flags.note: A board decision on an employee's criminal charges and an earlier warning about his conduct; voters may weigh it, but it involves a third party's charges. The article does not list each member's vote, but with six voting and one recused, it implies all three 2026 incumbents voted no. Editor: strong local story. Cover in Legal Insights news once board voting records are in; the three candidates' votes are part of it.

sources.title: Greater Clark board votes against terminating teacher contract
